title: Unit Event — Step by Step! — Episode6 Enjoying High School Life!

meta.Event Outline: Minori has told her groupmates in MORE MORE JUMP! that she wants to switch to the credit-based course. This hasn't been an easy decision to make, but she's been supported by some special people.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Let's see... Who can help me with this next problem...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, me! Pick me! Pleeease!
I can do it!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Oh, uhh... You're awfully peppy today, Hanasato. Then, please come to the front and solve this one for us.

rows.Speaker: Yamada
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The teacher just asked me to help set up their experiment. This is not how I wanted to spend the break...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Are you in need of assistance?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If it's an experiment that needs setting up, I can do that for you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yamada, you go enjoy your break!

rows.Speaker: Yamada
rows.Line:
But...
I-I'm not sure what's going on, but...thanks?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I got so much done today!
I even took over cleaning duties and made our classroom spotless♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
You were really busy today.
I've never seen you raise your hand so much during class.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's too bad that you got that problem spectacularly wrong.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That's not the point...!
My goal was to be an active participant during class!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I mean, what's going on?
Why were you acting like an honor student today?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You know how I was thinking about going credit-based? I've made my decision already...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Haruka and I are gonna be credit-based when we begin our second year.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, because I don't have much time left as a regular student, I wanna make the most of each day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After I go credit-based, we probably won't get to take classes, study or clean together as much as before...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Right...
That explains why you were running around like your hair was on fire.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! That's so mean! I was just trying to give today my all!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Shiho and I were wondering what you'd do, but I'm glad you seem happy with your decision.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, it's already this late?!
I need to get to work!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But if you plan on working full-time as an idol, doesn't that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I'm going to tell them that I'll be leaving today.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, I've gotta go!
See you tomorrow, Shiho, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
That's so great.
Minori's going straight after her dream.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Yeah...
I think that's pretty cool.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, actually...
Saki also said she has work this evening.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She and Minori might be on the same shift.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really?
Did they always work at the same...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh, are you two spreading rumors about me?!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I thought you had work today.
Minori left just a second ago.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, already?
But why? Our shift doesn't start for a while...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What if she's planning on being an “active participant” at work and not just school...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What do you mean?
Is she really fired up today or something?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I didn't know that...
So, Minori's really switching over to the credit-based course?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And she has to quit her job.
I'm really gonna miss her. We had so much fun working together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's so cool that she's pursuing her dream like that! I'm a little sad right now, but I wanna give her all the support I can!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Still...
I guess we're not gonna be able to hang out as much as we have been...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, Kohane, do either of you have plans after this?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, Kohane and I were just thinking about getting something to eat since we don't have practice today...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect!
Lemme have some of that free time so we can talk about my surprise plan together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh.
We actually need two more for my plan to work. So...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hello?!
Hehehe. I need to ask you for a favor...

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, you only have a few days left with us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yes...
As much as I don't want to stop working here...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um... Thank you very much for having me!
I promise to work as hard as I possibly can during the time I have left here!

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Hehe. I appreciate your enthusiasm.
And thank you for being such a wonderful employee.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line:
Still, becoming an idol full-time...
It's great that you're chasing after your dream.

rows.Speaker: Manager
rows.Line: Once you've made a name for yourself, I can tell everyone all about how you used to work here! Good luck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I promise to do my absolute best to make that happen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I heard all about what's going on!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
If you'll excuse us, boss!
Minori, you're coming with me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, what?! Where?!
But I still need to get changed!
